source_audit_note: Source-excluded non-adhoc direct RPC start-code identity guard. The unmodified HBASE-9721 regression JUnit passed and intentionally triggered the exact target exception twice; those are expected behavior, not a new bug. TestRegionMove healthy had 14 matching startcodes. Its passive fault mirror is evidence only.
check_code: if (regionServer.serverName.getStartcode() != serverStartCode) throw new ServiceException(new DoNotRetryIOException("This RPC was intended for a different server with startCode: ..."));
target_exception: ServiceException whose cause is DoNotRetryIOException and message identifies different server startCode
methodology_note: Original TestRegionMove JUnit. HBASE-31 target outcomes, exact I/O matches, production coverage and timing are projected into independent checkpoints from HBASE-12's unique JVM executions. A separate original regression test and source review classify this site as a non-adhoc direct start-code guard.

instrumentation_provenance.coverage: JaCoCo original HBase production classes including RSRpcServices

source_review: RSRpcServices.throwOnWrongStartCode(long) compares request serverStartCode directly with regionServer.serverName.getStartcode(). TestRegionServerNoMaster.testOpenCloseRegionRPCIntendedForPreviousServer constructs a stale ServerName and expects two exact guard exceptions. In the separate healthy TestRegionMove trace, 14 test-table target checks had equal startcodes and no exception. The source and traces support screening this check out of the multi-hop ad hoc coordination set.
runtime_accounting_note: Same JVM executions are attributed to HBASE-12; per-case totals are not additive.
screening_reason: The guard directly compares an RPC request serverStartCode with the current region server startcode; there is no multi-hop state composition at this check. Apache HBase already tests this exact expected rejection in its HBASE-9721 regression test.
known_regression_expected_exception: The original test deliberately uses ServerName(host, port, 1) for close/open and asserts ServiceException whose IOException cause contains "This RPC was intended for a different server".
